clues.text: This coaster climbs to a height of 80 feet, features 0 inversions, and travels at a modest top speed of 27 mph.
Constructed by pioneering manufacturer Arrow, this classic ride made its debut in 1959.
You can find this legendary family coaster operating in the sunny state of California.
This historic attraction holds a revered place in amusement park lore as the world's first tubular steel track roller coaster.
The ride's name refers to an iconic peak in the Swiss Alps paired with a type of winter racing sled.

evidence.quote: The ride is often considered the first tubular [[steel]] [[track]] roller coaster ever constructed.
It is based on the Swiss mountain, "[[wikipedia:Matterhorn|Matterhorn]]".
